crossRefs.note: They finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.

translations.web: They finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.
translations.bsb: and by the first day of the first month they had dealt with all the men who had married foreign women.
translations.kjv: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.
translations.asv: And they made an end with all the men that had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.
